lines.zh: 我走起来像拖着一层雾
lines.en: I walk as if dragging a fog
Soul sand is set into my legs

lines.zh: 我一步一步，沙在往下漏
lines.en: I step and sand leaks away
I walk toward sound
Nothing grows where I pass
My mane drifts like smoke
I stop at a pit and look down

lines.zh: 我的蹄子把地踩出暗色
lines.en: My hooves darken the ground
I head toward the campfire
Each step is slower than the last
I turn away and back again
My shadow falls against the light

lines.zh: 我的蹄子陷下去，留下暗印
lines.en: My hooves sink and leave dark prints
I move quieter than the wind

lines.zh: 我站着，身上有细细的声音
lines.en: I stand and something whispers inside me
My chest doesn't rise
Ash gathers at my feet

lines.zh: 我在听一个很远的调子
lines.en: I'm listening to a distant tune
My head is down, my eyes hollow

lines.zh: 灵魂沙在我的腿里慢慢磨
lines.en: The soul sand grinds in my legs
The grass leans away from me
My mouth opens, but no sound comes
I lift a hoof slowly
I wait for a rider
This place has gone dim
Wind passes through me like a hollow
I'm counting the shadows
I have none, and count anyway

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛像一缕向上的烟
lines.en: My mane rises like a wisp of smoke

lines.zh: 灰从我身上一片片剥落
lines.en: Ash flakes off me

lines.zh: 你身上的光在我这儿灭了
lines.en: Your light dies here

lines.zh: 我转过头，你看不清我的脸
lines.en: I turn and you can't make out my face
Ride me, and you'll be cold
There's ash on my back
Touch me; I may not be there
I wait for your palm

lines.zh: 你的声音在我这里很轻
lines.en: Your voice is very light here
I hear, and don't answer
Let's stand a while longer

lines.zh: 傍晚的风把我的轮廓吹淡。
lines.en: The evening wind thins my outline.

lines.zh: 你在灰里站着，我看得清
lines.en: You stand in the ash and I see you
There's no glint in my eyes
As you come near, the grass bends
I don't move, and neither do you
A corner of me thins out
I retreat, and the ash with me
A piece of me is missing

lines.zh: 我散成灰，又一点点立起。
lines.en: I scatter to ash and rise again bit by bit.
My foreleg breaks into a wisp of ash.
I lower my ashen head
The sand sound in me goes ragged

lines.zh: 我的灰身又被风扯散一些。
lines.en: The wind pulls more ash from my body.
My eyes go emptier
I'm still standing here
You hold something bright
It stirs the ash at my feet

lines.zh: 那点光让我退到灰堆后。
lines.en: That light drives me behind the ash heap.
I can't bear that warmth

lines.zh: 我的蹄印里只剩一层冷灰。
lines.en: Only cold ash is left in my hoofprints.
Set the light down and I'll come
It's white in my eyes
I can't smell it at all
But I know it's there
The torch's heat keeps me from gathering.
You hit me like plunging into cold fog
I thin out and gather again

lines.zh: 我的手在你背后来回穿。
lines.en: My shape passes back and forth behind you.
I step back and leave ash
We meet with a muffled thump

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过来，你没有感觉到
lines.en: My tail sweeps past and you don't feel it
I dip my head once
You pass through my side

lines.zh: 我把暗色的身子侧向一边
lines.en: I swing my dark body aside
I don't want to touch you
There's another in the fog
It's made of soul sand too

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，地面发暗
lines.en: We stand together and the ground darkens
Its voice is lower than mine
Our two ashen heads touch
Ash falls between us

lines.zh: 我们一起往前走了一段
lines.en: We walk a stretch together
The grass goes down under us
Neither of us need speak
Two together, and the fog thickens
I dip my head and take it up
It goes cold in my mouth
My mouth is empty
It falls from my mouth
I hook the thing closer with an ashen hoof.
It rolls away and I hear it
I don't need this
I bury it in the ash
It will forget itself soon
Go on, take it
You stepped into my ash
I raise my head slowly
My eyes are two empties
I take one hoof toward you
The grass bows under me
My ground is dark
My mane rises

lines.zh: 灵魂沙做的蹄子，跑起来发闷。
lines.en: Soul-sand hooves run with a muffled thud.
I stand at the stable door
You won't get past here
The sand in my legs quickens
I turn my head your way
I bear down on you, a step at a time
Ash churns under my hooves
You step back; I take one hoof in
The grass around has gone still
You hear the sand in my legs
I lower my head and my shadow covers you
You raise a hand and I don't yield
I run and raise a trail of ash

lines.zh: 你不用听我，你听得见灰
lines.en: You needn't listen for me; you'll hear the ash
I stop and let you move first

lines.zh: 我一步步压近，灰往前推
lines.en: I close in and the ash pushes ahead
You step back and grass goes down
All of this is dark ground
I drive my ashen head in
It lands heavy, with ash
I rear up

lines.zh: 我撞过去，自己散了半边。
lines.en: I charge and half of me scatters.
My mane brushes your face

lines.zh: 我的冷从你袖子钻进去。
lines.en: My cold seeps in through your sleeve.
I press you with my shoulder

lines.zh: 这一下我自己的身体也散了点
lines.en: That scattered part of me too

lines.zh: 我撞在门上，灰落了一地
lines.en: I hit the door and ash falls
I gather myself again
The ash at the door gathers

lines.zh: 我从一层薄雾里立起来
lines.en: I rise out of a thin fog
Sand moves inside my legs

lines.zh: 马厩旁边多了一匹暗色的马
lines.en: A dark horse appears by the stable

lines.zh: 草在我脚下都倒向外面
lines.en: The grass leans away from me
Not even ash sounds beneath my hooves

lines.zh: 我的轮廓一直不太清楚
lines.en: My outline never quite settles
The air here has gone cold
I raise my head and look it over
Someone's here; I can tell
Fog settles at the doorway
I raise my forequarters out of the ash

lines.zh: 地上多了一片不生草的暗痕
lines.en: A bare dark patch appears on the ground
My steps make no sound

lines.zh: 风把我的轮廓吹散一点
lines.en: Wind thins my outline
The dog in the house has stopped barking

lines.zh: 火一照，我的轮廓散了一半
lines.en: Firelight scatters half my outline
I fall and scatter into a heap of ash
Water falls and some of my ash drifts off

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得四处都是
lines.en: The blast scatters me everywhere
The arrow passes through and the hole closes
Magic pins what holds me together
My sand is running out
The flash lights every speck of ash

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我也散了
lines.en: Nothing below; I scatter too
